# The Japan News

> > Comprehensive English-language news source covering Japanese politics, society, business, and international affairs with breaking news and in-depth analysis.

The Japan News (by Yomiuri) is a major English-language news outlet providing coverage of Japanese government, politics, economy, and society. It serves as a primary source for international readers seeking updates on Japan-US relations, defense policy, imperial family news, and economic developments.

## Key Topics

- Japan
- Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi
- Japan-US Relations
- Japanese Politics
- Defense & Security
- Japanese Economy
- Imperial Family
- Tokyo
- Crime & Courts
- International Affairs
- Breaking News
- Elections
- G7 Summit
- Coronavirus/COVID-19
- Noto Peninsula Earthquake

## Core News Sections

- [Homepage](https://japannews.yomiuri.co.jp): Main homepage featuring breaking news, politics, business, culture, and comprehensive news coverage.
- [Latest News](https://japannews.yomiuri.co.jp/latestnews): Real-time news aggregator covering breaking stories, politics, Japan-US relations, and current events.
- [Most Read This Week](https://japannews.yomiuri.co.jp/ranking/week): Weekly ranking of the most-read articles across The Japan News.

## Politics & Government

- [Politics](https://japannews.yomiuri.co.jp/politics): Main politics section covering government, elections, and Japan-US relations.
- [Politics & Government](https://japannews.yomiuri.co.jp/politics/politics-government): Government news including Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi and international diplomatic affairs.
- [Defense & Security](https://japannews.yomiuri.co.jp/politics/defense-security): Defense policy, Self-Defense Forces operations, and military cooperation coverage.
- [Elections](https://japannews.yomiuri.co.jp/politics/election): Election news covering Lower House races, political campaigns, and voting updates.
- [Political Series](https://japannews.yomiuri.co.jp/politics/political-series): In-depth political analysis on Japan-US relations and diplomatic issues.
- [G7 Summit](https://japannews.yomiuri.co.jp/politics/g7-summit): G7 Summit coverage focusing on international diplomacy and multilateral cooperation.

## Society & Current Events

- [Society](https://japannews.yomiuri.co.jp/society): Main society section covering crime, imperial family, and social current events.
- [Crime & Courts](https://japannews.yomiuri.co.jp/society/crime-courts): Crime reporting and legal news covering police investigations and court proceedings.
- [Imperial Family](https://japannews.yomiuri.co.jp/society/imperial-family): Imperial family news covering the Emperor, Crown Prince, and succession matters.
- [Noto Peninsula Earthquake](https://japannews.yomiuri.co.jp/society/noto-peninsula-earthquake): Earthquake coverage and disaster recovery updates from the Noto Peninsula region.
- [Coronavirus](https://japannews.yomiuri.co.jp/society/coronavirus): COVID-19 pandemic coverage including health updates and public health policy.
- [Social Series](https://japannews.yomiuri.co.jp/society/social-series): In-depth series on immigration, foreign residents, and cultural integration in Japan.
- [General News](https://japannews.yomiuri.co.jp/society/general-news): General news feed covering regional events and community stories across Japan.

## Business & Economy

- [Business](https://japannews.yomiuri.co.jp/business): Main business section covering Japanese economy, companies, and market developments.
- [Japanese Economy](https://japannews.yomiuri.co.jp/business/economy): Economy news on stock market performance, infrastructure projects, and government economic policy.

## Optional

- [Obituaries](https://japannews.yomiuri.co.jp/society/obituaries): Obituaries and death notices of notable individuals.
